liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates the China Cat–Rider among the best; also praises The Other One as one of the best heard; Reviewer calls the China>Rider one of the best [24][26]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Brent's playing on this song; Brent's solo on this song was stellar [24][25]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer liked the opening Bertha, Promised Land and West L.A. Fade Away run [31]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Jams in Dupree's are among the best versions heard for energy and rawness [32]
- **My Brother Esau** (1 review): Brother Esau jam is likewise among the best versions heard for energy and rawness [32]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Jerry plays forcefully in the small, older venue's Stranger [27]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Jerry plays Eyes strongly [29]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Space contains a Spanish Jam [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-05.133026.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd84-10-05.sbd.sacks.2591.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 2.75/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has minor speed problems, especially in first set, likely from at least one cassette generation; Soundboard is not sped up at all, according to this reviewer [26][29]
- **gd1984-10-05.167673.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min [3]
- **gd1984-10-05.175442.nak.cm300.Sony.TCD5.kline.mattes.carbonetta.sirmick.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min [6]
- **gd1984-10-05.158246.FOB.NAK100-SG.Anon-Noel.t-flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min [8]. Said about its sound: Crackle in the PA, most noticeable during Little Red Rooster; tape pauses cross-faded; pitch corrected [8]
- **gd84-10-05.nak.grace-cole.15528.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 3.89/5 by 9 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard better than the audience recording, unusually for them [27]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first of over 120 shows; drove from Atlanta to Charlotte with a friend in a '73 Bug [23]
- Reviewer's first bootleg tape was of this show, though much poorer than this recording [23]
- Half the PA was out during the first set, and the old coliseum had bad echo [25]
- Uploader states Sunshine Daydream was not played [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-05.133026.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:02591) SBD> MC> Cass> DATs> CDRs> SHN and Audience (shnid:109982) 2 Beyer M160's & 1 Sennheiser 421 Microphones… [1]
- **gd84-10-05.sbd.sacks.2591.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBDMC> [no Cass?]> DATs> CDRs> SHN, with FOB Nak 300 patches by Scott Clugston; edited by Darrin Sacks from Blacula's seed; no Sunshine Daydream [2]
- **gd1984-10-05.167673.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: A 1:46 patch in Drums comes from a Sennheiser ME-80 source from Michael Hessberg [3]
- **gd1984-10-05.175442.nak.cm300.Sony.TCD5.kline.mattes.carbonetta.sirmick.flac2496**: taped by Jim Kline; transferred by Nick Carbonetta;SirMick; source: Nakamichi CM 300s > Sony TC D5 > Master Cassettes - taped by Jim Kline dec'd, from the collection of Ted Mattes [6]
- **gd1984-10-05.158246.FOB.NAK100-SG.Anon-Noel.t-flac2448**: transferred by Recorded, Transferred & Mastered by Anon Edited with add'l Mastering in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel May 29, 2022; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 100 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Master Cassette (TDK MA90s, Dolby B On) Location: approx. 40' from stage, mics spaced 3' apart on two Shure s15… [8]
- **gd84-10-05.nak.grace-cole.15528.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Nak 300 mics>Sony TCD5-M>DAT(via highly modified Sony ES)>CDR>EAC>CE2K>SHNTOOL>MKWACT [14]

claims.text: Reviewer's first of over 120 shows; drove from Atlanta to Charlotte with a friend in a '73 Bug
Reviewer's first bootleg tape was of this show, though much poorer than this recording
Reviewer rates the China Cat–Rider among the best; also praises The Other One as one of the best heard
Reviewer singles out Brent's playing on this song
Half the PA was out during the first set, and the old coliseum had bad echo
Brent's solo on this song was stellar
Soundboard has minor speed problems, especially in first set, likely from at least one cassette generation
Reviewer calls the China>Rider one of the best
Jerry plays forcefully in the small, older venue's Stranger
Reviewer finds the soundboard better than the audience recording, unusually for them
Jerry plays Eyes strongly
Sugar Magnolia has an odd intro, perhaps a mistake; Feel Like a Stranger slot is well jammed
Soundboard is not sped up at all, according to this reviewer
Reviewer liked the opening Bertha, Promised Land and West L.A. Fade Away run
Jams in Dupree's are among the best versions heard for energy and rawness
Brother Esau jam is likewise among the best versions heard for energy and rawness
Master cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Beyer mics used
A 1:46 patch in Drums comes from a Sennheiser ME-80 source from Michael Hessberg
Nakamichi CM300 source, Sony TCD5 deck; tape flips patched from another source; transfer by Nick Carbonetta, compiled by Ted Mattes
Crackle in the PA, most noticeable during Little Red Rooster; tape pauses cross-faded; pitch corrected
Space contains a Spanish Jam
Uploader states Sunshine Daydream was not played
